title: YouTube Video & Audio Downloader
description: Paste a public YouTube URL, choose video or audio, and get a hosted download link. From $0.10/GB on Business or $0.125/GB on Starter; Free is $2.50/GB. No extra Actor run platform or proxy fees, FlashData key or cloud setup.

url.title: YouTube video or Shorts URL
url.description: Paste one public YouTube watch, Shorts or youtu.be HTTPS link. One completed file per run.

download_type.title: What to download
download_type.description: Choose a video with its audio, a silent video, or an audio-only file. Default: video with sound.

output_format.title: File format
output_format.description: Choose MP4, WEBM or MKV for video; M4A, MP3 or OPUS for audio. Leave blank to use the default for your download type.

video_quality.title: Video resolution
video_quality.description: Choose a resolution ceiling (<=) or exact resolution (==), from 144p to 2160p (4K). Default: up to 1080p. Availability depends on the source; no upscaling. Leave blank for audio only.

fps.title: Video frame rate (FPS)
fps.description: Optional source frame-rate constraint, for example <=30 or ==60. Supports <=, == or >= and 1–240 FPS. Leave blank for audio only.

audio_quality.title: Audio bitrate (kbps)
audio_quality.description: For audio-only downloads: choose best available, 320, 256, 192 or 128 kbps. Leave blank for video with sound or silent video.

audio_language.title: Source audio track
audio_language.description: Select the default or original audio track already available on the source. This does not translate audio. Leave blank for silent video.

maxFileMB.title: Maximum file size (MB)
maxFileMB.description: Hard ceiling for the completed file: 50 MB by default, up to 800 MB. The run budget can reduce this limit. Under the current conservative budget check, $0.125 allows up to 50 MB. This is a budget ceiling, not a fixed charge. Oversized downloads produce no download event.
